svg.title: Ground to orbit: a lights-out factory, a driverless truck, a reusable booster
svg.desc: A neon night scene. In a lights-out factory a robot arm loads a rocket upper stage onto a driverless truck, which drives itself to the launch pad. The stage is stacked on a reusable booster, the countdown runs, the rocket lifts off, and the booster comes back down and lands on the pad. In the foreground Nitish rides past in a self-driving car with an empty driver's seat, raises his coffee and says stuck it.
